verdict: Cboe's profit jumped as record options trading — led by same-day-expiry index options — lifted net revenue 18%, with a $72M gain on selling its Australian business adding to the headline number.

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: a record, vs $2.85 a year ago

segments.name: Derivatives markets
segments.note: Options and futures exchanges — the biggest piece. Index options volumes rose 24%, helped by record trading in options that expire the same day (0DTE).

segments.name: Cash and spot markets
segments.note: Stock exchanges in North America and Europe plus foreign-exchange trading. This line includes $156M of regulatory fees collected and largely passed through.

segments.name: Data Vantage
segments.note: Selling market data, index licensing and analytics — record quarterly revenue, and the most subscription-like part of Cboe.

opex.name: Compensation & benefits
opex.note: Pay for the people who run the exchanges and build the technology.

opex.name: Depreciation & amortization
opex.note: Wear and tear on trading systems and buildings, and amortization of bought intangibles.

opex.name: Technology & professional services
opex.note: Technology support services ($28M) plus professional fees and outside services ($25M), rounded so the lines tie exactly.

opex.name: Other operating expenses
opex.note: Travel and promotion ($8M), facilities ($6M), a $1M asset impairment and $20M of other expenses — which include a $14M reserve on notes receivable funding the Consolidated Audit Trail.

otherDetail: A $72M gain on selling Cboe Australia, plus $20M of net non-operating income (interest income and investment earnings, less interest expense), less $2M of profit allocated to participating securities — net +$90M shown in the chart.
oneTimers: A $71.5M gain on the sale of Cboe Australia, completed in the quarter, is included in GAAP results. Excluding it and other adjustments, adjusted EPS was $3.63 (non-GAAP) versus GAAP EPS of $4.08.
Operating expenses include a $14.0M reserve on notes receivable connected with funding the Consolidated Audit Trail (the SEC's market-surveillance system), and a $1.4M asset impairment.

takeaways.title: Options are booming
takeaways.text: Net revenue — what Cboe keeps after paying liquidity and clearing costs — rose 18% to a record $712M. Options net revenue rose 23% as index options volumes grew 24% on record same-day-expiry (0DTE) trading.

takeaways.title: A record quarter, with help
takeaways.text: GAAP EPS hit a record $4.08, up 43%. About $0.68 of that came from the one-time $71.5M gain on selling Cboe Australia; adjusted EPS of $3.63 was still up 36%.

takeaways.title: Guidance went up
takeaways.text: Cboe raised its 2026 organic net revenue growth target to 'high teens' from 'mid to high teens', lifted Data Vantage to 'mid teens', and lowered its adjusted expense guide to $830–845M.

footerNote: Reported operating income of $534M includes the $72M gain on selling Cboe Australia; this page shows that gain in Other income (the same treatment as other divestiture gains on this site), so the operating-profit block reads $463M. Net income is the $427M allocated to common stockholders (total net income $428M). Cboe reports in tenths of millions; lines are rounded to whole $M and tie exactly.
